edits.old: Then the grant refuses the statement and the boundary test fails the build
edits.new:
Then the grant refuses the statement and the boundary test fails the build

  Scenario: AC6 Rules BR1 to BR12 (section 8)
    Given the rules of section 8 are in force at their versions
    When the step runs on case "RC-2026-000534" holding asset "AST-2026-000534"
    Then each rule BR1 to BR12 holds as written in section 8

  Scenario: AC7 Error answers 401 and 404
    Given a request without a valid session and a request for an unknown case
    When the operations of section 12 are called with them
    Then the answer is 401 for the first request and 404 for the second, and nothing is written

  Scenario: AC8 Replay of a write with the same idempotency key
    Given a write already completed under an idempotency key
    When the same write is replayed with the same idempotency key
    Then no second listing row, instruction or answer is written and the first result is returned

  Scenario: AC9 Activity retry and timeout
    Given the Partner.issueInstruction activity fails or times out
    When the workflow retries it on the workflow schedule inside the Temporal budget
    Then no second instruction is issued for the same listing

  Scenario: AC10 Consumed call fails or does not answer
    Given the rwb-case contract fake does not answer for "RC-2026-000534"
    When the step reads the case state
    Then the step waits and retries on the workflow schedule inside the Temporal budget, nothing is written and no move is answered

  Scenario: AC11 Disallowed status change is refused
    Given the case "RC-2026-000534" in state ROUTE_WITH_APPROVER
    When a status change the route model does not allow is requested
    Then the change is refused, nothing is written and the case keeps its state
